text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Admire Vega got injured,
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...... I was told not to move
until the injury is healed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Something felt off, but I ignored it.
Looks like that came back to bite me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Still, just because of that,
I can't afford to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I'm going to run.
I'll continue my training.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on treatment for now.
Let's think of a way we can still train.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I have no choice but to train
more than anyone else.
That's the only thing I can do.
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, you won't even be able to race.
If it gets worse, you won't even be able to race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
.............
You're right.
You're right, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Admire Vega rested quietly, though she still seemed unconvinced.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking she might still train areas
other than where she hurt herself,
she came to the gym, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It seems to twinge where I got hurt.
Still, if you dwell on it... nggh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, although she stopped training, it took quite a while before she fully recovered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, I tried securing the injured area
with taping, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, doesn't seem to hurt.
I think I can do this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That saved me for now.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, taking careful measures to avoid placing any strain on the affected area,
we were able to complete the training session without incident.
